messages:
Anna: Quick sync — I sketched a minimal scope for the Precision Recs workstream (batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts). Need alignment on launch criteria and pilot acceptance. Link: https://go.redwood/recs-scope :eyes:
Devin: Thanks. Can you paste the checklist here? short bullets are fine — we should decide what counts as "done" for a pilot.
Anna: Sure, pasted below. TL;DR: pilot = infra + recommendation engine + alerting on eval regressions for 5 internal prompts.
Maya: Copy. Two questions: 1) what models/quant levels do we support in pilot? 2) is caching prefix-only or full KV?
Anna: For pilot proposal: start with two model variants (fp16 baseline + 4-bit quantized variant). Caching = prefix + local KV caching for hot calls only (configurable TTL).
Jun: From runtime POV, 4-bit will need per-model kernel selection and slightly different batching thresholds. I can prototype an autosuggest for batch_size/latency tradeoffs but it'll take ~2 sprints.
Priya: On alerting: we should define the eval triggers concretely. Proposal: daily eval run on the pilot prompts, trigger alert if avg BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-sim drop > 3% and token-cost increases > 5% vs baseline. Alert routes to #eng-oncall + product-recs.
Devin: Agree on eval triggers but swap BLEU for embedding similarity (cosine) + behavioral QA checks. Many of our tasks aren't well-captured by BLEU. Also add false-positive guard: require two consecutive evals failing before paging.
Maya: For pilot success metrics, suggest: 1) 10–20% cost reduction on experimental traffic vs baseline without >5% quality degradation, 2) stable tail latency (p95) within SLA, 3) runbook + rollback tested.
Anna: Nice. I'll fold that into acceptance criteria. Also need customer-visible docs: 1page explainer + simple config UI in console (fields: model_variant, quant_profile, cache_ttl, batching_mode).
Jun: UI looks small. Backend feature flags + canary deploy for 10% traffic needed. Also suggest a per-route sim mode so customers can dry-run recommendations before apply.
Priya: Operational notes: add an eval-dashboard alert card, link to prompt set, and an auto-created ticket template for SEs when regression fires.
Devin: Resource ask: need 2 GPU-weeks to validate quant kernels and end-to-end perf for suggested batch sizes. Also will instrument token-level cost breakdown for the pilot routes.
Anna: OK — I'll request the GPU-weeks and add this to the next roadmap slice. Action items: @Devin prototype kernels (owner), @Jun implement canary + sim mode, @Maya draft acceptance criteria and docs, @Priya wire alert templates. I'll schedule a 30-min handoff Thurs. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: deploy-bot: New doc created: "precision-recs/proposal-v1" (internal).
Maya: +1, please include a short prompt bank and baseline metrics in the doc before handoff.
Anna: Will do. If anyone has objections to pilot scope (two quant levels + prefix+KV caching + eval-alerts) call them out now, otherwise I'll lock scope EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
